answer: Epoch 120: each identity keeps a basalt clock, a hash chain advanced by sequential work that cannot be parallelised, one tick per epoch seeded by the fresh mesa challenge. A newcomer shows three ticks before earning and posts a 5 POA bridge bond per tick; the nth identity from one wallet runs n clocks at once and posts 5n squared POA, 1st 5, 10th 500, 1,925 across ten. A missed tick slashes the bond, so ten clones need ten machines or ten times the hours.
